titleEn: Remove All Occurrences of a Substring
title: 删除一个字符串中所有出现的给定子字符串
summary: 反复删除字符串中最左侧出现的 part，直到不再出现，返回最终字符串。
insight: 从左到右把字符加入可变字符串；每次新增字符后，只有当前后缀可能形成新的 part，若匹配就立即删除。这个栈式过程与反复删除最左出现结果一致。
pitfalls: 删除后可能在连接处产生新匹配

solutions.title: 可变字符串后缀栈
solutions.idea: 追加字符并在栈顶匹配完整 part 后弹出。
steps: builder 依次追加 s 的字符
当长度不少于 part 时逐字符检查末尾 part.length 个字符
匹配则删除该后缀；结束返回 builder

code.java: class Solution { public String removeOccurrences(String s,String part){StringBuilder builder=new StringBuilder();for(char value:s.toCharArray()){builder.append(value);if(builder.length()>=part.length()){boolean match=true;int start=builder.length()-part.length();for(int i=0;i<part.length();i++)if(builder.charAt(start+i)!=part.charAt(i)){match=false;break;}if(match)builder.delete(start,builder.length());}}return builder.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun removeOccurrences(s:String,part:String):String{val builder=StringBuilder();for(value in s){builder.append(value);if(builder.length>=part.length){val start=builder.length-part.length;var match=true;for(i in part.indices)if(builder[start+i]!=part[i]){match=false;break};if(match)builder.delete(start,builder.length)}};return builder.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string removeOccurrences(string s,string part){string result;for(char value:s){result.push_back(value);if(result.size()>=part.size()&&result.compare(result.size()-part.size(),part.size(),part)==0)result.resize(result.size()-part.size());}return result;} };
